facts.fact: UNHCR says it and the Government of Nigeria launched the Digital Gateway with the National Commission for Refugees, Migrants and IDPs, letting asylum-seekers start pre-registration and request registration appointments online, beginning in Abuja with gradual expansion elsewhere; about 140,000 refugees and asylum-seekers and 3.68 million IDPs are counted.
